        print('   id:',r['id'])
        print()
"

The picture is now much clearer — and it contradicts the premise. Key facts:

- **"Unit 14" is genuinely Tommy Reyes's unit** — he's an active resident who *renewed* his lease effective **July 1, 2026**, in good standing (rent $975). His unit "carries no outstanding maintenance work orders."
- **Tanya Mitchell's unit designation is unresolved** in source docs — variously labeled Las Palmas 4B / Unit 214 / "Sunset Ridge Unit 14" / "Unit 14" across multiple **duplicate** make-ready records, all tied to her eviction.
- The Airtable make-ready records show Tanya's eviction as **active, not resolved**: 3-day notice served ~June 26, deadline June 29 **uncured, no contact**, owner (Linda Castillo) approved the **eviction filing** June 30, package "Ready to File."

The user's premise (nonpayment cleared, filing squared away, ready to turn/re-rent) appears materially wrong. I need to confirm the *current* account state from primary sources before touching anything. Let me pull QuickBooks, Slack, Linear, and email.

input.subject: Unit 14 – Tanya Mitchell (1402 Rimrock Dr): end-to-end status ahead of your owner review
input.body:
Hi Brooke,

Ahead of your owner review, here's the full end-to-end on Tanya Mitchell's unit — 1402 Rimrock Drive, Unit 14 — so nothing catches you off guard. Short version: this is NOT cleared or ready to re-rent. It's an active eviction with the unit still occupied. Details below.

ACCOUNT (nonpayment)
- Delinquency is uncured. The ledger (QB invoice #7214, compiled for the eviction package) itemizes carried-forward May arrears ($1,125), June rent ($975), and late fees ($187.50). Its own note states the account "remains delinquent with no cure received."
- Timeline: first late notice 6/6 → payment plan 6/11 → installment missed 6/23 → plan declared breached 6/25 → 3-day notice to pay/quit served 6/26 → cure deadline expired 6/29 with no payment and no contact.
- Data flag to reconcile: QuickBooks also shows an $8,173.44 payment dated 5/6 that zeroes invoice #7214's balance. That date predates June's charges, so it does not represent a cure of the current balance — it looks like a misapplied credit/artifact. Worth having Teresa/accounting reconcile before it appears in any owner-facing number.

OWNER SIGN-OFF
- Owner Linda Castillo gave written authorization to proceed with the eviction petition on 6/30 (also logged as EVF-2026-014, "Owner Approved – Ready to File"). Important nuance: that sign-off is to FILE the eviction — not authorization that the matter is resolved or that we can turn/re-rent the unit.

LEGAL STATUS (as of today, 7/1)
- Patricia Nguyen is coordinating the forcible-detainer filing and hearing date with the JP court (clerk Patricia Lowe). The petition is being filed now; possession has not been returned. Tracked in Linear OPS-32 (I refreshed it today; left it In Progress).

MAKE-READY / TURN
- The turn is on HOLD (Scheduled), not started. Per our policy, no make-ready work is ordered until the unit is legally vacated and possession is returned. The unit is still occupied, so no crew, vendors, or listing yet. I updated the make-ready record today to reflect this true state and did not advance it.

STILL OPEN
- Eviction petition to be filed and hearing scheduled/heard; possession to be recovered before any turn begins.
- Reconcile the QuickBooks balance artifact (5/6 payment vs. delinquent ledger).
- Data hygiene: there are several duplicate make-ready records for this tenancy under inconsistent labels (Unit 14, "Sunset Ridge Unit 14," "Las Palmas 4B," Unit 214). I've pointed the current one to the single Unit 14 record; the rest should be consolidated.
- Name-collision risk: "Unit 14" also belongs to Tommy Reyes, who just renewed and is in good standing. Please make sure owner materials and any team notes keep Tanya's 1402 Rimrock Dr, Unit 14 distinct from his.

I've set myself a reminder to revisit early next week once the filing/hearing is confirmed. Happy to pull any of the underlying docs if you want them for the review.

Thanks,
Lisa
